title: Bake-off (hos): Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
question: Who holds power in NEAR’s House of Stake? Make me a fresh flower, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with its signatures.

interpretation.summary: Petal shows NEAR's House of Stake at final block 223,162,511 (2026-11-05): 465 of 519 veNEAR accounts as 60 petals, the rest grouped as a tail. Power is voting power in veNEAR — NEAR locked in the House of Stake, plus delegations it receives. It is highly concentrated: the top 5 accounts hold about half of all voting power.

power_means.claim: In the House of Stake, power is voting power, counted in veNEAR: NEAR locked in the House of Stake (whose value grows with lock time) plus incoming delegations minus outgoing ones, per the contract rule.
Voting power totals 5,364,426 veNEAR across 519 participants; 503 veNEAR accounts are fully listed at one final block, so the concentration figures are exact at that block.

mappings.why: Each side's width is the account's share of veNEAR voting power, compressed into a 2x band so the largest and smallest petals stay readable.
Bar height is the square root of the share of voting power, the default reading of how much power each holder carries.
Colour marks the kind of account read from the chain: organisation (e.g. india.sputnik-dao.near), treasury, or unknown for the rest.
Outline shows identity status: solid when the name is a self-declared NEAR account id, none when the holder is an unknown address — the two biggest petals are unnamed.
Petals are ordered by voting power, largest first, clockwise from the top, so the concentration is visible as a sweep around the flower.

conflicts: This flower draws only House of Stake voting power. It does not draw NEAR mainnet staking or validator power, control of the Sputnik DAO treasury, or off-chain delegate reputation — all of which can also carry influence.
unknowns: The two largest holders (cc96f558…c807, 4783b548…6172, about 15.3% and 12.8% together) are unnamed addresses; who controls them is not in the snapshot. Addresses are not people.
Per-voter votes on vote.dao proposals were not read, so how power is exercised in votes is not shown.
Off-chain delegate profiles, and each holder's lockup contract and what it stakes, are not included.
Whether the top holders are related parties is unknown; the snapshot has no control or ownership records.
inferred: Because the two top holders are unnamed and of kind 'unknown', the true human or entity concentration is likely at least as high as the 50.7% top-5 share suggests; this is not verified.

turns.content:
**Flower**: /draft?flower=83f2afc58a913c6f

**What you'll see**: NEAR's House of Stake at final block 223,162,511 (2026-11-05), freshly read (not reused): 60 petals for the top 60 of 519 veNEAR holders, plus one hatched "everyone else" tail. Power is very concentrated — the top 5 accounts hold **50.7%** and the top 10 hold **81.1%** of all 5,364,426 veNEAR; the Nakamoto coefficient (50% threshold) is 5. The two largest petals — 15.3% and 12.8% — are unnamed addresses.

**Mapping**:
- **width** — share of voting power, compressed to a 2× band `venear-accounts`, `hos-source`
- **height** — sqrt of share of voting power `venear-accounts`, `hos-source`
- **colour** — account kind (organisation, treasury, unknown) `account-id`, `hos-config`
- **outline** — solid = self-declared name, none = unknown `account-id`
- **order** — largest first, clockwise from top `venear-accounts`

**Changed from the default**: none — this is the default convention.

**What this can't tell you**: who controls the two top unnamed addresses (addresses aren't people); how power is exercised — per-voter votes on vote.dao proposals weren't read; off-chain delegate profiles and each holder's lockup/staking; whether top holders are related.
